literal: That which was intended attaining is easy indeed, again oneself that which was intended to remember if gets.
translation: It is easy to attain what one intended, if one can only keep that intention constantly in mind.
modern: ஒருவர் தான் எண்ணியதை மறக்காமல் மீண்டும் மீண்டும் நினைவில் கொள்ள முடியுமானால், அவர் எண்ணியதை அடைவது மிகவும் எளிது.
explanation: This couplet states that achieving one's goals is remarkably easy, provided one does not lose sight of them. The word 'உள்ளியது' refers to what is thought of or intended as a goal. By repeating this word and pairing it with 'உள்ளப் பெறின்' (if one manages to remember), the poet emphasizes that constant mindfulness and freedom from negligence are the true keys to success.
